title: Day 766: Gunmen Shoot Up and Torch Apartment Building in Culiacán's Montebello Sector, Rescue Woman and Two Children
detail: Armed men arrived in at least two vehicles before dawn on Friday, August 28, 2026, and opened fire on a four-story apartment building on Calle Montebello between Monte Cáucaso and 22 de Diciembre, in the Montebello sector of Culiacán, near the Rafael Huelna elementary school. One vehicle was rammed into the building's gate to breach it before the attackers set an apartment ablaze; investigators later recovered more than 100 spent shell casings from long guns at the scene. Firefighters used a telescopic ladder to reach the rooftop and rescue a woman and two minors trapped by the fire; Civil Protection paramedics treated them for nervous shock, and no one suffered gunshot or burn injuries. Mexican Army personnel secured the perimeter while state prosecutors' forensic teams processed the scene. No arrests were announced.

media.caption: Firefighters rescue a woman and two children from a burning apartment building attacked by gunmen in Montebello, Culiacán, August 28, 2026

title: Day 766: Interim Governor Domínguez Details Federal-Backed 'Plan Integral de Seguridad y Gobernabilidad'
detail: Interim Governor Graciela Domínguez Nava said on August 27–28, 2026 that a team sent by the Presidency of the Republic is working with her administration 'a toda velocidad' on a Comprehensive Security and Governance Plan, with a progress update to be presented the following week alongside visits to all 20 of Sinaloa's municipalities. The plan rests on two pillars: restoring citizen security through daily coordination meetings, and reviving the state economy — including support for the microenterprises that account for roughly 70% of Sinaloan employment via the federal 'Equipa Sinaloa' program. Domínguez, who took office August 25 after Congress named her Sinaloa's second interim governor of 2026, also addressed Morena Senator Enrique Inzunza's recent departure from the party's Senate caucus, saying he should have prioritized party loyalty, and reiterated she is working closely with President Sheinbaum.

media.caption: Interim Governor Graciela Domínguez Nava details Sinaloa's federal-backed security and governance plan, August 28, 2026
